nameOfQualification: Senior Technician - Digital Manufacturing and Tool Engineering
description: The Candidate will be able to Design, Estimate, Process Plan, Manufacture, Assemble and Try out Press tool, Mould and Jigs and Fixture. Will have Exposure on the use of Industrial Automation - Pneumatics and Hydraulics, PLC, Robotics, IIoT, Additive ManufacturingThe subjects covered in this programme are - Mould Technology, Press Tool Technology, Additive Manufacturing, Tool Design Drawing, Automation - Digital Manufacturing, 3D Printing Lab, CAD/CAM, CNC Technology, Production technology, Metrology, Jigs and Fixtures, Material Technology and Heat Treatment, Strength of Materials, Industrial Management, Production Management Control, Estimation and Costing, Automation - Pneumatics and Hydraulics.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PREVNSQFLEVELSACHIEVED: Previous relevant Qualification of NSQF Level 4
eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONCOMPLETED: Advance Certificate - Assistant Tool Maker Level 4.0 from NTTF

acadprog: Post Diploma, B. VoC and B.Tech Degree Course in Relevant areas
horizontalPathName: After 3 years of industry experience, the job holder can work as Tool and Die Engineer, Process Engineer, Product Design Engineer, Tool Designer, Digital Manufacturing Engineer, Digital Quality Engineer, or Additive Manufacturing Engineer.
verticalPathName: With relevant experience and demonstrated competency, the job holder can progress to Senior Tool Designer, Senior Tool and Die Engineer, Senior Process Engineer, Senior Product Design Engineer, Tool Room Supervisor, Production/Manufacturing Supervisor, or Technical Manager.
